notes.title: Blocky Farm is available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Enter the charming world of Blocky Farm, where you can manage your lands, take care of animals, harvest fields, deliver goods to the town, and build friendships with citizens. Create the farm of your dreams and watch it grow big! Start your village life today!


[b]CARE FOR YOUR ANIMALS
[/b]Meet a variety of adorable animals on your farm! Care for them, accessorize them with fun gadgets, and enjoy playful moments together. The happier they are, the greater your rewards will be!

[b]GROW YOUR FARM
[/b]Expand your farm by constructing new buildings, setting up fields, and planting a diverse array of crops! Strategically plan your layout to maximize efficiency and watch your farm flourish.

[b]DELIVER YOUR GOODS
[/b]The citizens of the nearby town are counting on your fresh supplies! Visit the town, sell your goods, and reinvest your earnings to enhance your farm's growth.

[b]MAKE LASTING FRIENDSHIPS[/b]
The townsfolk aren’t just customers; they’re potential friends! Engage with them, build relationships, and create a sense of community in your village life.
